systems.tiers: Planned: terminals in health centres and equipped village collection agents are to send birth data to the civil registration services of the sub-prefectures and town halls; first tests in Abidjan called conclusive, national extension to follow (June 2026)

note: The document states ONECI's training of local-language speakers and planned transmission of birth data to the registration services in sub-prefectures and town halls; an application, with no connection at a local government office stated.
